title: 基于向量索引的输出嵌入加速LLM推理
summary: 针对大词汇量紧凑型LLM在自回归解码中的内存带宽瓶颈，将输出投影和top-k选择重构为最大内积搜索，用HNSW向量索引替代密集投影，仅检索少量高得分token。在Gemma 3、Llama 3.2和Qwen 3上，端到端吞吐量提升最高82%，且保持生成质量。
summary_en: Reformulates output projection and top-k selection as maximum inner product search, replacing dense vocabulary projection with an HNSW vector index to retrieve only a small candidate set. On CPU inference with Gemma 3, Llama 3.2, and Qwen 3, end-to-end throughput improves by up to 82% while preserving quality.
